boot.slowTitle.text: Ana ci gaba da buɗe ƙauyenku…

boot.slowBody.en: This is taking longer than usual. Keep this screen open while your village loads.
boot.slowBody.text: Wannan yana ɗaukar lokaci fiye da yadda aka saba. Ku bar wannan allon a buɗe yayin da ƙauyenku ke lodawa.

boot.unsupportedBody.en: Update your browser or Android System WebView, then try again. Your saved village stays on this device.
boot.unsupportedBody.text: Ku sabunta burauzarku ko Android System WebView, sannan ku sake gwadawa. Ƙauyenku da aka adana yana nan a wannan na'urar.

boot.languageError.en: Your language could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
boot.languageError.text: An kasa loda harshenku. Ku duba haɗin intanet ɗinku ku sake gwadawa.

common.unknownError.en: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
common.unknownError.text: Ba a iya kammala aikin ba. Don Allah ku sake gwadawa.

boot.missing.en: This browser is missing: {detail}. Update your phone (iOS 15 or later) or your browser (Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox from 2021 or later), then open Kagemura again.
boot.missing.text: Wannan burauzar ba ta da: {detail}. Ku sabunta wayarku (iOS 15 ko sama) ko burauzarku (Chrome, Safari, Edge ko Firefox na 2021 ko sama), sannan ku sake buɗe Kagemura.

boot.realSlow.en: Kagemura is taking a long time to load
boot.realSlow.text: Kagemura na ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo kafin ya buɗe

boot.realSlowBody.en: Nothing has moved for a while. It keeps loading in the background, or you can start again.
boot.realSlowBody.text: Babu abin da ya motsa na ɗan lokaci. Yana ci gaba da lodawa a bayan fage, ko kuma ku iya sake farawa.

boot.failureBody.en: Check your connection and try again. Your village is saved on this device.
boot.failureBody.text: Ku duba haɗin intanet ɗinku ku sake gwadawa. An adana ƙauyenku a wannan na'urar.

boot.description.en: Kagemura: Ninja Clans. Build a hidden mountain village, train warriors, and raid rival strongholds.
boot.description.text: Kagemura: Dangin Ninja. Ku gina ƙauyen ɓoye a cikin duwatsu, ku horar da mayaƙa, ku kai hari kan sansanonin abokan hamayya.

boot.pwaDescription.en: Lead a ninja clan: build a hidden mountain village, train warriors, and raid rival strongholds with smoke and sabotage.
boot.pwaDescription.text: Ku jagoranci dangin ninja: ku gina ƙauyen ɓoye a cikin duwatsu, ku horar da mayaƙa, ku kai hari kan sansanonin abokan hamayya da hayaƙi da zagon ƙasa.
